D5/S1/Digit/ZeckendorfAvoidanceCount.uni.name: D5.S1.Digit.ZeckendorfAvoidanceCount.uniform_avoidance_count
D5/S1/Digit/ZeckendorfAvoidanceCount.uni.signature: theorem uniform_avoidance_count (H : ℕ) : ((legalWords H 0).filter (fun w => decide (¬ B1 <:+: w))).length ≤ Real.goldenRatio ^ (H + 1) * (1 - (Real.goldenRatio ^ (14 : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ (H / 14)
